title: Existing Q3 fifth-moment authority to endpoint third-moment bridge
question: Does the already-closed fixed-beta Q3 onsite fifth moment imply the endpoint third moment required by EXP-001059 without an extensive volume factor?

model.onsite_operator: k_x=h_site-xi_0-delta_1 P_1 >= 1 at zero source in the registered periodic Q3 family
model.spectral_shift: A0=max(0,xi_0+delta_1+r^2/(2*g)); the finite one-site spectral owner supplies A0<infinity
model.form_domination: e(q_x) <= k_x+A0 because p_x^2/(2*chi) and the omitted scalar are nonnegative in the onsite form
model.fifth_to_third: k_x>=1 implies k_x^3<=k_x^5; the existing uniform m5 therefore bounds both endpoint third moments

finite_fixture.fixture_scope: arithmetic self-test only; not a physical spectral enclosure

no_overclaim: The bridge closes only the endpoint third-moment input in the registered periodic zero-source scope. It does not close the direct D or delta-D limits, history summation, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS identification, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A. The compact-source extension requires a separate uniform affine form-domination row for A0.
